name: Medi-Cal (Medicaid)
description: Medi-Cal is California's Medicaid program, providing free or low-cost health coverage to millions of Californians including low-income adults, families, seniors, pregnant women, and people with disabilities.
fullDescription: Medi-Cal is California's Medicaid program, providing free or low-cost health coverage to millions of Californians including low-income adults, families, seniors, pregnant women, and people with disabilities.
whatTheyOffer:
- Doctor and hospital visits
- Prescription medications
- Preventive care and screenings
- Mental health services
- Dental care (Medi-Cal Dental)
- Vision care
- Substance use treatment
- Long-term care services
howToGetIt: Apply online at CoveredCA.com or BenefitsCal.com, through your county social services office, or by phone with Covered California at 1-800-300-1506 (Mon-Fri 8am-6pm). Adults generally qualify with income up to 138% of the poverty level (266% for children), or if they get CalFresh, SSI/SSP, or CalWORKs. You can apply any time of year and must renew once a year. Some benefits for certain adults are changing based on immigration status, so check with your county office.
keywords: Medi-Cal, Medicaid, free health insurance, low-income, doctor, hospital, prescription, mental health, dental, vision, CoveredCA
